rubric.role_summary: Experienced ML engineer building production recommendation, ranking, and personalization systems, including user modeling and LLM-integrated pipelines for an AI product.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Experienced ML engineer building production recommendation, ranking, and personalization systems, including user modeling and LLM-integrated pipelines for an AI product.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Hands-on experience building production recommendation, ranking, or personalization systems.
- Strong machine learning fundamentals.
- Experience integrating LLMs into ranking, retrieval, or personalization pipelines.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with large-scale ranking and training infrastructure, such as multi-stage retrieval and ranking, feature stores, or real-time serving.
- Background in user understanding, feed ranking, notifications, growth, or lifecycle modeling.
- Deep, hands-on experience building production recommendation, ranking, or personalization systems at scale.
- Strong ML fundamentals covering areas such as engagement modeling, model calibration, offline and online metrics, and online experimentation.
- For tech leadership roles only: prior experience setting technical direction for recommendation or ranking projects.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
